newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Nae Wae issues convertibles in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Nae Wae issues convertibles in Europe.

text.p: Nae Wae Semiconductor Co Ltd, one of South Korea's leading computer makers, said on Friday it has issued 10 million Swiss francs of convertible bonds in Zurich.
The company said in a statement said the proceeds would be used to help finance the company's capital investment.
It said the bond, with a five-year maturity, would carry a 0.125 percent coupon and a 29.58 percent conversion premium.
It has a three-year put option, which carries a yield of 4.527 percent.
The issue was arranged by Sunkyong Securities and Schroders Securities.
